label: OneDrive or SharePoint Backup Folder
description: Sends Backup Set and archive CSV files to a OneDrive folder through Microsoft Graph. Make the connection in Setup first (an Auth Provider for Microsoft, then an External Credential and a Named Credential named BarnConn_onedrive with the URL https://graph.microsoft.com and principal OAuth), as the admin guide's Backup Destination section describes. The path writes to the BarnCRM-Backups folder of the signed-in account's OneDrive; for a SharePoint library, change /me/drive to /sites/SITE_ID/drive.
